# GOV.UK header

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use the official GOV.UK header on authorised GOV.UK services to identify the site and link consistently to the GOV.UK homepage.

## When to use

- Use the official component for services that are part of GOV.UK and authorised to display its crown and logotype.
- Pair it with Service navigation when the service needs a service name or service-level links.

## When not to use

- Do not use the GOV.UK crown or logotype for a service outside the GOV.UK proposition or without identity approval.
- Do not recreate, redraw or substitute the protected identity asset from these documentation records; use the official GOV.UK Frontend component and assets.

## Anatomy

- **Header (required):** The GOV.UK header component establishes the official site identity.
- **Width container (required):** The inner content aligns with the page grid.
- **GOV.UK homepage link (required):** The official crown and logotype link to the GOV.UK homepage with the supplied accessible name.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `header` | `govuk-header` | The standard GOV.UK site identity above Service navigation or main content. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- The current GOV.UK header itself requires no component JavaScript; initialise any separate Service navigation beneath it.
- Use the official template or macro so identity markup and assets stay aligned with the pinned GOV.UK Frontend release.
- Do not inline an invented or extracted logo in framework adapters.

## Accessibility contract

- Preserve the official accessible name, link semantics and focus treatment supplied by GOV.UK Frontend.
- Keep the header readable at high zoom and do not place application content over the identity.
- Avoid duplicate GOV.UK homepage links with the same accessible name in the header.

## Content rules

- Do not alter the GOV.UK logotype text, crown or relationship between them.
- Put the service name and service-level links in Service navigation, not inside a custom header imitation.
- Follow the GOV.UK identity and domain guidance before publication.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.brand`
- `govuk.color.inverse-text`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.layout.page-width`

## HTML examples

### Official macro required

```html
<!-- Render the GOV.UK Frontend header macro/component from the pinned release. -->
<header class="govuk-header">
  <div class="govuk-header__container govuk-width-container">
    <div class="govuk-header__logo"><!-- Official GOV.UK homepage link and supplied logotype asset go here. --></div>
  </div>
</header>
```
